notablePrerequisites: Pith Driller does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrifiicing Pith Driller.
When Pith Driller dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Pith Driller enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Pith Driller trigger, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger from step 3, untapping it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
